concepts.label: Material discrepancy
concepts.definition: Any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
concepts.quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

unit_attributes.statement: A material discrepancy means any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

concepts.label: Material discrepancy explanation
concepts.definition: Explanation required from an applicant regarding discrepancies across application, citizenship evidence, and identity evidence.
concepts.quote: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity

unit_attributes.scope_text: When there are material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity.
unit_attributes.logic_text: between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.object_quote: any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.object: any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity

qualifications.statement: Applies when there are material discrepancies between the name on the application, citizenship/nationality evidence, and identity evidence.

unit_attributes.statement: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

concepts.label: Documentation of material discrepancies
concepts.definition: Required documentation for material name discrepancies among passport application, citizenship evidence, or identity evidence.
concepts.quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section

unit_attributes.scope_text: When material discrepancies exist between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity, except for married names as provided in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).
unit_attributes.choice_text: one or more of: (1) Court orders or decrees, consisting of (a) Name change orders, or (b) Divorce decrees; (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
unit_attributes.logic_text: one or more of the documents listed in this section: (1) Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders; or (b) Divorce decrees; (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
unit_attributes.action_quote: must be documented by submission of
unit_attributes.object_quote: one or more of the documents listed in this section
unit_attributes.object: one or more of the listed acceptable documents (court orders or decrees including name change orders or divorce decrees, certificates of naturalization, marriage certificates, documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law, or documentation of customary usage)

qualifications.statement: An exception applies for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).

unit_attributes.statement: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section (court orders or decrees including name change orders or divorce decrees, certificates of naturalization, marriage certificates, documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law, or documentation of customary usage), except for married names under 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).

concepts.label: Review of material name change evidence
concepts.definition: Mandatory inspection of evidence of material name changes for counterfeiting or alteration.
concepts.quote: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration

unit_attributes.scope_text: When reviewing evidence of material name changes.
unit_attributes.logic_text: for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration
unit_attributes.statement: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1).

concepts.label: Prohibition on using previous name
concepts.definition: Restriction on an applicant continuing to use a previous name after a material name change unless explicitly authorized.
concepts.quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name

unit_attributes.scope_text: After a material name change, unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.
unit_attributes.logic_text: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name

qualifications.statement: The applicant may continue using a previous name if the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.

unit_attributes.statement: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).

concepts.label: Evidence of identity requirement possibility
concepts.definition: Potential requirement under regulation to provide evidence of identity to establish the applicant's identifying name.
concepts.quote: under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant

unit_attributes.statement: Under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant, as the applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.

concepts.label: Application suspension for ID update
concepts.definition: Mandatory suspension of a DS-11 application to request ID in the new name when a material name change occurred more than one year prior without an updated ID.
concepts.quote: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

typed_values.name: material name change timing threshold
typed_values.quote: more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11

unit_attributes.scope_text: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change.
unit_attributes.logic_text: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change

qualifications.statement: Applies if the applicant had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on Form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change.

unit_attributes.statement: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

concepts.label: Limited-validity passport issuance for urgent travel
concepts.definition: Permission to issue a limited-validity passport when acceptable ID cannot be obtained prior to urgent or emergency travel.
concepts.quote: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name

typed_values.name: material name change timing threshold
typed_values.quote: more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11

unit_attributes.scope_text: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, and there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel.
unit_attributes.logic_text: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel

qualifications.statement: Applies when the applicant had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on Form DS-11 without updating ID, and there is insufficient time to request submission of acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel.

unit_attributes.statement: If the applicant had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID, and there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name.

concepts.label: Name change documentation for ID change
concepts.definition: General necessity of name change documentation for an applicant to change the name on their ID.
concepts.quote: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

unit_attributes.statement: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

concepts.label: Notation and return of name change documentation
concepts.definition: Duty to fully notate name change documentation, including 'seen and returned', prior to returning it with an information request letter.
concepts.quote: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL)

unit_attributes.scope_text: Prior to returning the name change documentation to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL).
unit_attributes.logic_text: prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL)

qualifications.statement: Notation must occur prior to returning the documentation to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL).

unit_attributes.statement: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL).

concepts.label: Exemption from submitting ID in new name
concepts.definition: Exemption from submitting ID in the new name for applicants with a material name change within one year of applying on Form DS-11.
concepts.quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

typed_values.name: material name change timing threshold
typed_values.quote: within one year of applying on a form DS-11

unit_attributes.actor: applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11

qualifications.statement: Applies to applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a Form DS-11.

unit_attributes.statement: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

concepts.label: Submission of name change documentation when ID unchanged
concepts.definition: Duty to submit name change documentation if ID has not yet been changed within one year of applying on Form DS-11.
concepts.quote: However, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.

typed_values.name: material name change timing threshold
typed_values.quote: within one year of applying on a form DS-11
